name: Neural Toxin Filtration
target_system: neural/hepatic (enhanced blood-brain barrier and toxin metabolism)
description: Enhances the blood-brain barrier with additional filtration proteins and introduces honey badger-derived toxin resistance across all organ systems. The user becomes highly resistant to neurotoxins, including most venoms, nerve agents, and pharmaceutical compounds that target the nervous system. The modification also accelerates general toxin metabolism through enhanced liver and kidney function. The user is not immune to all poisons — concentrated industrial toxins and purpose-engineered bioweapons can still be lethal — but they can survive doses that would kill an unmodified human several times over. Crucible Genomics developed it as a companion modification for TTX and venom gland users, preventing accidental self-poisoning, but it has found a broader market among people who work with hazardous materials, live in contaminated environments, or simply want insurance against assassination by poisoning.
source_organism: Mellivora capensis (honey badger), Didelphis virginiana (Virginia opossum, venom resistance proteins)
procedure: Systemic retroviral injection targeting blood-brain barrier and metabolic organs, 4 sessions over 2 months
expression_time: 4–8 weeks for enhanced filtration; full toxin resistance at 3 months
reversibility: Partially reversible; blood-brain barrier modifications persist
side_effects: Dramatically reduced effectiveness of anesthetics, painkillers, and recreational drugs — the body neutralizes them too quickly
Alcohol tolerance becomes extreme — social drinking is impossible without extraordinary consumption
Medical procedures requiring sedation are complicated by rapid drug metabolism
Rare: filtration system targets beneficial compounds including some foods and supplements
social_perception: Practical and quietly respected. Poison Proof users are considered cautious rather than paranoid. The modification is invisible and socially neutral — unless someone tries to poison the user and fails, in which case it becomes very relevant very quickly.
story_hooks: A Poison Proof user survives a poisoned meal that kills everyone else at the table — they're now the prime suspect, because how did they know to protect themselves?

A Clean Brain user's enhanced filtration begins stripping essential neurochemicals from their brain, causing progressive emotional numbness — the blood-brain barrier can't distinguish between toxins and necessary compounds
